objective: Measure the local signed response of the exact FSHC inference operator on frozen Ctrl-World development replays and materialize direction or abstention evidence for training.
hypothesis: Across three fixed seeds per development context, at least one context has a locally coherent nonzero FSHC signed-gain response whose weighted gain lower confidence bound supports a direction label; contexts that fail locality or confidence must abstain.
selection_reason: The earlier one-seed canary proved hook identity and activation only. This is the minimum frozen multi-context, multi-seed frame that can estimate local response covariance without reading the held-out context.
falsification_criterion: The campaign is invalid if any identity, zero-dose reference, hook activation, fixed action trajectory, checkpoint binding, dose symmetry, or seed repeat is missing; its direction hypothesis is rejected per context when locality or the predeclared gain lower bound fails.
artifact_policy: Retain every immutable identity shard, stdout/stderr log, GPU runtime receipt, merged result, input SHA256, zero-dose video, and response atlas; never overwrite an existing campaign directory.

protocol.threshold_freeze_timing: Frozen after 2 of 9 development identity shards completed but before aggregation. Labels are development supervision only and are not preregistered effect evidence.

probe_paths.transformation: apply fixed gain d through h_i'=h_i+d*(current-h_i) using the exact norm-bounded FSHC operator

outcomes.name: negative_mean_l1
outcomes.description: Negative mean RGB L1 over all replay interactions.

outcomes.name: negative_horizon_l1_slope
outcomes.description: Negative slope of interaction-level RGB L1; higher means less autoregressive drift.

claim_scope: Mechanism-aligned fixed-dose FSHC response measurement on development contexts. It creates direction or abstention labels only; it is not trained-model improvement evidence.
formal_next_gate: Freeze direction labels, train without episode IDs, and evaluate only on independently held-out contexts.
